info.title: csff
info.description: A fast C# formatter CLI written in F#.

options.name: --check
options.description: Report unformatted files without rewriting them

options.name: --write-stdout
options.description: Print one file, or stdin when no path / '-' is supplied

options.name: --ignore-path
options.description: Use this ignore file instead of discovered ignores

options.name: --include-generated
options.description: Include generated file names and leading comments

options.name: --no-cache
options.description: Neither read nor write the formatting cache

options.name: --cache-path
options.description: Store bounded per-input-root caches in DIR
